name: Glen Cove
seo_title: Christmas Events for Kids in Glen Cove, NY 2026
seo_desc: Christmas events for kids in Glen Cove, NY for 2026: the downtown BID Holiday Festival with carriage rides, Santa and a tree lighting.
lede: Glen Cove packs its Christmas into one Saturday afternoon downtown, with horse and carriage rides, choo choo trains, Santa, the Grinch and a tree lighting.
celebrates: The Glen Cove Downtown Business Improvement District holds its Holiday Festival in Village Square on Saturday, December 5, 2026, from 1:30 to 4:45 pm. The listing promises a Holiday Craft Fair, free horse and carriage rides, choo choo train rides, photos with Santa and a special visit from the Grinch. Local school and community groups perform from 1:45 pm, and the afternoon ends with the Christmas Tree Lighting at 4:45 pm, with hot cocoa and candy canes. Parking is free in the Brewster Street and Pulaski Street garages downtown, which keeps the day easy for families with strollers.
lastyear: We did not find a published 2025 recap of the Glen Cove Holiday Festival on a host page, so this page relies on the 2026 listing from Visit Glen Cove and Sea Cliff, the local events calendar. That listing describes the day as the Downtown BID's Holiday Festival and gives a full performance schedule, which suggests an established annual event. The same calendar lists a Breakfast with Santa at a local church on the same morning.
facts: The festival takes place in Village Square in downtown Glen Cove, and the listing names free parking in two downtown garages. Performances run in short slots from 1:45 to 4:30 pm, so families can drop in for part of the afternoon. The listing is on a tourism calendar for Glen Cove and Sea Cliff rather than a village page, so confirm details with the BID before you go.
trains: Ride the rails to the holidays. The MTA says the Long Island Rail Road's Holiday Lights Train, a locomotive covered in thousands of lights, runs along all electric branches from Monday, November 23 into January, so families who ride the LIRR this season may spot it. Check the LIRR timetable before you plan a train trip to the events on this page, and bring the children to the window to look for the glowing locomotive.
traditions: Vendors and craft makers fill Village Square for the afternoon.
Free rides around the downtown during the festival.
A small train ride for younger children.
The festival ends with the village Christmas tree lighting, hot cocoa and candy canes.
kidfact: Glen Cove's festival has free horse and carriage rides and a visit from the Grinch as well as Santa.
faq: How does Glen Cove celebrate Christmas?
The Glen Cove Downtown BID holds a Holiday Festival in Village Square with a craft fair, carriage and train rides, Santa and the Grinch, then lights the Christmas tree at 4:45 pm.
Is the Glen Cove Holiday Festival free?
The listing shows free admission and free horse and carriage rides, and parking is free in the Brewster Street and Pulaski Street garages.
When is the Glen Cove tree lighting in 2026?
Saturday, December 5, 2026, at 4:45 pm in Village Square, at the end of the Holiday Festival.
